stories.headline: Alphabet Must Show This on Oct. 28 or the Stock Could Stall
stories.body: Key PointsGoogle Cloud has already proven it can make money. What it hasn’t proven is that the money shows up as cash, and that’s the line to check on Oct. 28.

stories.headline: Heartened by sponsor-bank success, a Connecticut bank eyes SBA
stories.body: DR Bank in Darien, Connecticut, is ready to branch out as a national digital lender after building a successful business in sponsor banking.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
stories.body: Wall Street’s Big Three have generated $52 billion in equity trading revenue this year, capturing about 80% of the market on rising margin lending to hedge funds.
